description.value: Bench Campground in Sasquatch Provincial Park offers easy paved access 6 km off Highway 7 near Harrison Hot Springs, set among pocket lakes and birch forest with sandy beaches and warm summer swimming on Hicks and Deer lakes; swimmer's itch is occasionally reported.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is the official BC Parks page for Sasquatch Provincial Park, which explicitly names 'Bench and Lakeside campgrounds' in the map section, confirming this is a real frontcountry campground within the park. The site prominently features a 'Book camping' button and a 'Reservation policies' section covering frontcountry camping, confirming reservations are accepted. No specific cyclist amenities (water, showers, tools, etc.) are described on the page, so those fields default to null; OSM's internet_access=no tag is noted but not corroborated by the website for amenity purposes.
concerns: The website URL points to the parent Sasquatch Provincial Park page rather than a dedicated Bench Campground page; amenity details specific to this campground (water, showers, bear boxes, etc.) are not surfaced and would require a deeper page or direct contact to verify.

The phone number (+1-604-986-9371) and email (info@seatoskyparks.com) belong to the third-party operator Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd., not BC Parks directly; the website does not display these contact details for cross-confirmation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Bench Campground is a legitimate, operational BC Parks frontcountry campground with 64 sites near Harrison Hot Springs; it is a clear fit for the WWC directory as a confirmed camping option for touring cyclists on the Highway 7 corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: A 'Bench and Lakeside campgrounds map [PDF]' is linked from the park page and may contain additional amenity details not captured in the fetched text.
